title: Aston Martin DB5 vs DB12: The Difference Nobody Explains
description:
Sixty years separate two Aston Martins that share a badge and a purpose. The nineteen sixty-three DB5 made two hundred eighty-two horsepower and needed eight seconds to reach sixty. The current DB12 makes six hundred seventy-one, and does it in three point six. But the numbers hide the real difference, and one of them runs the opposite way to what you expect. Every figure here is sourced. Our sources are Wikipedia's pages on the DB5 and the DB12, Kelley Blue Book's pricing page for the twenty twenty-five DB12, the Hagerty valuation page, an RM Sotheby's catalogue, Top Gear and several others. Where they disagree, we show both figures. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
